任务的停止与调整时限: Stopping a task and changing its time limit
点开「任务」里的一个任务：进行中的可以暂停或停止（分轮出题的叫「停在这里」，已通: Open a task in “Jobs”: a running one can be paused or stopped (a task that works in rounds says “Stop here” and keeps every question that passed), and a stopped one can be continued with “Continue”. Question tasks, course outlines and review books all show their time limits and elapsed time in the details; “Adjust time budget” takes you to “Settings › Question defaults” to change the per-round or single-call time limit (or enter 0 for no limit), applying to tasks started afterwards.
把这一页或这一章译成中文或英文，译文显示在对应段落旁；翻译在后台进行，可以继续阅: Translates this page or chapter into Chinese or English, with the translation shown beside each paragraph. It runs in the background so you can keep reading, and a translation you already have needs no model.
选中一段原文后，可以把题补到一个现有题组里：生成的题经过独立审核，通过的增量保存: After selecting a passage you can add questions to an existing deck: the generated questions are reviewed independently, the ones that pass are saved incrementally and linked to that passage.
资料先归档，之后可以恢复，只有已归档的资料才能永久删除。页面右上角的「已归档」（: A material is archived first and can be restored later; only an archived material can be deleted for good. “Archived” at the top right (in a narrow window, under “More” beside “Add source”) lists the materials that were put away; each row’s “More” menu has “Archive”; and after ticking several under “Organize courses” you can use “Archive selected”.
勾选资料后统一改它们属于哪门课，原文与引用保持不变；也可以先点「请 AI 建议」: Tick materials and change which course they belong to in one go; the text and citations stay as they are. You can also click “Suggest with AI” first and apply the suggestions after reading them.
文字读不出来、公式多，或超过 8 MB 的 PDF，可以先在本机解析成带页码的文: A PDF whose text cannot be read, has many formulas or is over 8 MB can first be parsed on this computer into text with page numbers and then saved as a material. It is part of the audio component and uses MinerU or Marker.
已经有题目，或是别的 AI 生成的题，可以直接导入：JSON 题组会存为草稿，检: If you already have questions, or questions made by another AI, import them directly: a JSON deck is saved as a draft, to be checked and then published.
长案例加开放题，按评分标准逐项批改；这门课考案例题时，在这里出题。: A long case with open questions, graded criterion by criterion. If your course has a case exam, make questions here.
给一次出题设一个 token 上限（例如 2M）：用到了就在一轮结束时停下，已通: Set a token limit for one run (for example 2M): when it is used up, the run stops at the end of a round and keeps every question that passed. Leave it empty for no limit.
这次出的题偏基础还是偏难：混合、基础理解、应用迁移、深入辨析。默认值在「设置 ›: Whether this run’s questions lean basic or hard: mixed, foundational, applied or in-depth. The default is changed in “Settings › Question defaults”.
这次出的题用什么语言写：中文、English 或中英双语。默认值在「设置 › 出: The language this run’s questions are written in: Chinese, English or both. The default is changed in “Settings › Question defaults”.
题目里的公式怎么写：自动、纯文本或公式（LaTeX）。纯文本更稳定，公式适合数学: How formulas are written in questions: automatic, plain text or formula (LaTeX). Plain text is steadier; formulas suit maths and chemistry. The default is changed in “Settings › Question defaults”.
写一句这次想练什么（例如「区分相似模式，重点练习工程场景中的取舍」），出题会侧重: Write a line about what you want to practise (for example “tell similar patterns apart, practise trade-offs in engineering cases”) and the questions lean towards it. You can also make questions without it.
不知道练什么时点它：它只发送资料标题和目录，不发送全文；没有模型时，会改用你的错: Click it when you do not know what to practise: it sends only the material titles and outline, never the full text, and without a model it suggests from your mistakes instead.
上传自己教材里的优质题目，或选已导入的样题：出题只参考题型、难度和表达方式，要求: Upload good questions from your own textbook, or pick sample questions you already imported: they are used only for question type, difficulty and wording, new questions are still original, and facts and answers still follow the textbook. The chosen samples are sent to the model with the materials, which adds input tokens.
草稿里还有资料小节没有题时，点它按小节补一轮题；开着「自动补到完整」会一轮接一轮: When a draft still has parts of the materials without questions, click it to top up one round by part. With “Fill up automatically” on, rounds follow one another until every part has questions. The cost is estimated first. The Study library’s unpublished row and “Jobs” have this entry too.
草稿页的「覆盖」一栏用一行写覆盖了几个小节、占百分之几，下面一句话说出题计划是否: The “Coverage” box on the draft page gives one line with how many sections have a question and what percent that is, and one sentence under it saying whether the question plan is finished and how many sections are outside it; how the rounds were split is in “Generation details” on the draft page. A question task in Jobs has the same box, where “Plan progress” only says how much of the plan is done.
页面底部的操作栏: Action bar at the foot of the page
草稿页底部操作栏里的「更多」（⋯）菜单：点「删除草稿」会先问一次，确认后永久删除: In the “More” (⋯) menu in the action bar at the foot of the draft page: “Delete draft” asks once, and after you confirm it permanently deletes the questions of this draft that are not published yet; the materials and published decks stay.
点开「任务」里一个已结束的任务，详情右上角的「更多」（⋯）菜单里有「删除任务记录: Open a finished task in “Jobs”: the “More” (⋯) menu at the top right of its detail has “Delete task record”. The record leaves the list at once and can be undone for a few seconds; materials, drafts and decks stay. A running task cannot be deleted. You can also tick several finished tasks and delete them together from the bar above the list.
AI 出的题先放进草稿：你可以逐题核对、修改或删除，确认无误再发布，发布后就能开: Questions made by AI go into a draft first: check, edit or delete them one by one, then publish, and you can start practising. “Save & validate” and “Publish and start practising” are in the action bar at the foot of the page, which stays in view while you scroll through the questions.
草稿页「题目」一栏里折叠着「高级编辑」，里面的「JSON 编辑」可以直接用 JS: On the draft page, “Advanced editing” is folded in the “Questions” section; its “Edit JSON” changes this draft directly as JSON.
做题时点「提示」先看线索；揭晓答案以后，它变成「讲解」。按 H 键也能打开。: Click “Hint” while answering to see a clue; once the answer is revealed it becomes “Explanation”. The H key opens it too.
答案揭晓后，如果这道题引用的那一页里有图，而且这份资料还留着原文件，「引用与来源: Once the answer is shown, if the page this question cites has a figure and the material still has its original file, “See the figure on the original page” appears under “Check citations & sources”. One click opens the material with that page of the original file already up (the whole page, not cropped to the figure). The converted text keeps no pictures, so this is the way to the figure. It is not shown when the question cites nothing, the cited page has no figure, or the material has no original file; without one you can use “Add the original file…” in the material.
卡住了点它：后台助教会结合原文讲解这道题、补上前置知识。讲解会出现在这道题下面的: Click it when you are stuck: a background assistant explains the question with the original text and fills in the prerequisites. The explanation appears under this question, in its Q&A; the inbox tells you when it is done, without interrupting you.
把想法存下来：在题目下方的「更多」里选「写笔记」。存下的笔记收在「学习笔记」里，: Keep your thoughts: choose “Write a note” in “More” below the question. Saved notes are collected in “Study notes” and can jump back to the question.
把这道题移入斩题组，不再复习；斩掉的当时可以点「撤销」，恢复到原题组。: Moves this question to the slain deck so it is no longer reviewed; right then you can click “Undo” to put it back in its deck.
选好这一轮练什么（只练错题、加上同类题，或加上变式），点「开始重练」，把待巩固的: Choose what this round covers (the mistakes only, with similar questions, or with variants) and click “Start retraining” to go through the questions that need work again along the learning path; after filtering you can also practise only the filtered ones, and with several groups each one has its own “Practise this group”.
点开一道错题的详情，能看到题库里已有的同类题，可以直接去练；页面上的「为你推荐」: Open the details of a mistake to see similar questions already in your bank and practise them directly; “Recommended for you” on the page is the same kind of thing, and to practise them with your mistakes choose “Mistakes + similar” under Retrain.
为错题改写新的变式题：每道题约 1 次轻量模型调用，一次有题数上限；错题只有一道: Rewrites mistakes as new variant questions: about one light model call per question, with a limit on how many at a time. With one mistake use the “Generate variants” beside it; with several the page also has “Generate variants for all mistakes”. Finished ones go to “Personalised”; click “Practise” to start.
直接从题库里找相似的题：同主题、引用同一页，或关键词相近，已排除你刚答对的；不消: Finds similar questions straight from your bank: same topic, citing the same page or close keywords, leaving out ones you just got right. It uses no model. This line only says what was found; to practise them choose “Mistakes + similar” under Retrain and click “Start retraining”.
列表上方的筛选栏: The filter row above the list
错题满 10 道，列表上方才出现这一排：按主题或按题组分组、全部展开 / 全部收: This row appears above the list once you have 10 mistakes: group by topic or by deck, expand or collapse all, filter by deck, status or text, and “Only this deck” beside each group. With fewer than 10 you can see everything at a glance, so the row is left out.
错题页不再有「刷新」按钮：打开着的时候它每隔几秒自己看一眼，有新的错题或错题已订: The mistakes page no longer has a Refresh button: while it is open it checks for itself every few seconds and updates when there is a new mistake or one has been corrected, leaving the groups and questions you opened as they are.
同一天、同一课程只保留一篇合集，累计完成 10 道不同题目才生成；默认关闭，开启: Only one collection is kept per day and course, and it is made once you have finished 10 different questions. It is off by default and uses the current AI model when on. The collections are kept in “Study notes”.
后台替你做完的事（改题、前置题、讲解、译文、批改、音频转写、PDF 转换……）完: When the background finishes something for you (question fixes, prerequisites, explanations, translations, grading, audio transcription, PDF conversion…), the inbox tells you; an explanation, a new question or an edit itself is on the question. Click an item to jump back to that question or result; “Mark all as read” only clears the badge and deletes nothing.
在这里切换选择题笔试、案例分析卷和口头面试，都是限时作答；交卷后给出成绩单和逐题: Switch here between the multiple-choice written exam, the case paper and the oral interview, all timed. After you hand in you get a report and an explanation for each question, and the case paper is graded criterion by criterion.
每门课可以记下考试形式、总分、作答和阅读时间、考试日期，也能放入老师的考试说明、: Each course can record the exam format, total marks, answering and reading time and exam date, and can hold your teacher’s exam notes, key topics and an optional target role and JD (for written or oral interview preparation); the days left until the exam show beside the course title. Choose “Course settings…” at the end of the course title’s menu, or go to “Settings › Courses”.
课堂实录可以用 Gemini（云端，要密钥），也可以用本地转写：声音不上传，不需: Live class can use Gemini (cloud, needs a key) or local transcription: the sound is not uploaded, no key is needed, and it has to be installed first. Choose in “Settings › Audio transcription”; it can also be installed on the “Live class” page.
学习库是你电脑上的一个文件夹，资料、题组和复习记录都保存在里面；在这里选它放在哪: The library is a folder on your computer that holds your materials, decks and review records; choose here which folder it is.
页面顶栏的「模型：…」写着出题、讲解和批改现在用的是哪个模型，免得不知不觉花掉: The “Model: …” chip in the top bar names the model that making questions, explanations and grading use right now, so you do not spend API fees by accident. It is not shown until a model is set up (the status then says “No model yet”). Hover it or focus it with the keyboard for its explanation; click it to open “Settings › Library & model” and change the model. On the desktop edition the explanation also says how the model is billed: by usage to your API key, or against the quota of the account the local CLI is signed in to (by usage when that CLI is signed in with an API key). In a narrow window it shrinks to an icon and in a narrower one it is hidden; look in “Settings › Library & model” then.
出题、讲解和提问需要一个 AI 模型，在这里选用哪个；模型的密钥在 DSH 的「: Making questions, explanations and asking need an AI model; choose which one here. The model’s key goes in DSH’s “Settings › Model”, not here.
转写录音要填一个密钥：按 Gemini 免费、硅基流动、Groq、Gemini: Transcribing a recording needs one API key (such as Groq or free Gemini; paid Gemini is optional, and SiliconFlow is available for direct connections in mainland China). When several keys are saved, StudyHub falls back across them automatically.
给上百页的大教材用：在「设置 › 检索扩展」的「检索：只让 AI 看相关页面」装: For textbooks of hundreds of pages: install the search extension and build the index of the course in “Settings › Search extension”, under “Search: let the AI see only the relevant pages”. After that, making questions from a whole book reads only the relevant pages, which uses fewer tokens and stays on topic; a selection over 150,000 characters is narrowed with it first. The index is built on this computer: no AI is called, it uses no tokens and your material never leaves the computer; the first build downloads a search model of about 90 MB, once. For a book of 150 pages or more that has no index yet, “Build the search index first” appears under the file list of Add source, on the finished conversion card and its Conversion history row beside “Customize this book in depth”, and in More › Whole book; the line above the list on the Sources page (“N materials have no finished index · Build index”) and the one beside Add source under the list on the Create deck page (“N not fully indexed · Build index”) do the same, and its hover says what the index is for. Click any of them to come straight here.
换一个强调色：朱砂是默认，另有几种可选。只换强调色，其他不变。: Pick an accent colour: cinnabar is the default and a few others are available. Only the accent changes.
选界面字体和标题字体；也可以填本机已安装的字体名，找不到会用系统字体。: Choose the interface font and the heading font; you can also type the name of a font installed on this computer, and the system font is used if it cannot be found.
调卡片、按钮这些东西的圆角大小。: Adjust how rounded cards, buttons and similar things are.
默认无音效；可开「轻柔」（翻面、判分、完成一轮）或「标准」（再加上多选点选与标重: Off by default; switch on “Subtle” (flipping a card, checking an answer, finishing a round) or “Standard” (adds a light tap when picking multi-choice options or marking focus), and press “Preview” beside it to listen first. Automatically muted while recording or in live class.
高对比会加深边框和次要文字、加粗焦点框；跟随系统时，遵循系统的“增加对比度”设置: High contrast darkens borders and secondary text and thickens the focus ring; when it follows the system, it obeys the system’s “Increase contrast” setting.
把整套外观带到另一台电脑：点「复制外观设置」（或「下载为文件」），在那边点「导入: Move the whole look to another computer: choose “Copy appearance settings” (or “Save as file”), then on the other one choose “Import appearance” and paste or pick the file. You see it once “More appearance options” is open.
一键把语言以外的外观（明暗、强调色、大小、音效、字体、动画、对比度、密度、圆角）: Put every appearance setting except the language (light or dark, accent colour, size, sound effects, fonts, animation, contrast, density, corners) back to its default in one click.
看这一页能用的键；按 ? 也能打开。: See the keys that work on this page; pressing ? opens it too.
切到每个关键功能，边走边看怎么用。先走主线（模型、资料、出题、草稿、练习），看完: Switches to each key feature so you can see how it works. It starts with the main chain (model, materials, questions, draft, practice) and you can then take the full tour; pause any time and continue later.
把鼠标放上去（或用键盘聚焦），会列出界面里这些词的意思：主会话、总纲、覆盖强度、: Hover over it (or focus it with the keyboard) to list what these words in the interface mean: main chat, course outline, coverage strength, prerequisite questions, study library and deck.
载入过示例课程后，可以在这里移除示例数据，你自己的资料和记录不受影响；也可以重新: After the sample course has been loaded you can remove the sample data here; your own materials and records are not affected. You can also load the sample again or retake the tour.
导出会下载一个完整的 JSON 备份：资料、题组、复习进度和作答记录都在里面。恢: Export downloads a complete JSON backup with your materials, decks, review progress and answer records. Restore replaces the current library with a complete backup, and the current data is saved automatically first.
给课程填了考试日期后，这门课每次作答的下次复习不晚于考试日（当天 0 点起出现）: Once a course has an exam date, the next review after each answer in that course is no later than the exam day (it shows up from midnight that day). Saving the exam date spreads that course's questions already due after the exam over the days before it, the ones you are most likely to forget first; for an exam date set before this version, press Align now next to the switch (the exam date in the course settings says how many questions wait). Only review dates change, not the memory estimate or mastery. A question answered on the exam day can only come back after the exam; removing the exam date or switching this off gives the old dates back. After the exam day, new answers are scheduled as usual; questions that were brought forward and not answered stay due until you answer them or press Restore original dates here. Next to the switch it says roughly how many more or fewer reviews each of the next 14 days would get. The switch shows only when a course has an exam date ahead; on by default.
从已有的本地学习库（study-lib-spar）导入，保留可迁移的复习记录。: Import from an existing local library (study-lib-spar), keeping the review records that can be moved.
看当前版本、已安装版本和最新已知版本，检查更新；有新版本时，侧栏底部也会提示。升: See the current, installed and latest known versions and check for updates; the bottom of the sidebar also says so when a new version is out. If DSH was restarted after an upgrade and the old version still runs, the sidebar and this page say why, and offer a reinstall or the manual steps.
只记录你用了哪些控件、各用了多少次（按天累计），不记录任何内容和名字；只保存在这: Records only which controls you used and how many times (per day), never any content or names; it stays on this computer and can be viewed, exported, paused and deleted any time. Off by default.
显示实验性功能的总开关，默认关闭；关掉后它们全部隐藏并停止，里面已有的选择会保留: The master switch for showing experimental features, off by default; when off they are all hidden and stopped, and choices already made in them are kept.
内置功能做不了的事，点「发给主会话」：StudyHub 把写好的话填进主会话的输: For what the built-in features cannot do, click “Send to the main chat”: StudyHub puts the message into the main chat’s input box and you press send; without a main chat it is copied to the clipboard.
输入一个词（中文、英文或常见叫法都行）就能找到功能在哪，选中后「带我去」会切到那: Type a word (Chinese, English or a common name all work) to find where a feature is; after selecting it, “Take me there” switches to that page and puts the focus on the control. Press Ctrl K (⌘K on a Mac), or / when no text field has the focus, to open it too.
语言、外观、强调色、界面大小、互动音效在最上面；字体、动画、对比度、密度和圆角在: Language, appearance, accent colour, interface size and sound effects are at the top; fonts, animation, contrast, density and corners are in “More appearance options”; you can also copy the look or save it as a file and take it to another computer
公式的大小和对齐、图片的显示方式，以及化学配平和代数恒等式两个在本地计算的小工具: Formula size and alignment, how images are shown, and two small tools that compute locally: chemical balancing and algebraic identity checking
选学习库放在哪个文件夹，也选用哪个模型出题；模型的密钥在 DSH 的「设置 ›: Choose which folder the library lives in and which model makes questions; the model’s key goes in DSH’s “Settings › Model”
新出题任务的默认值：题型、覆盖强度、语言、难度、公式写法，以及同时处理几批、每轮: Defaults for new question-making tasks: question types, coverage, language, difficulty, formula notation, how many batches run at once, the time limit of each round and how many extra rounds fill in automatically
把一天里答错的题整理成一篇讲解合集：是否自动准备、默认的讲解口吻和按哪个时区算一: Turns the questions you got wrong in a day into one explanation collection: whether it is prepared automatically, the default tone and which time zone counts as a day
每天的练习怎么走：每轮题数、自动跳下一步、本轮点评、多少次答错算顽固题，以及期末: How the daily practice goes: questions per round, auto-advance, the round comment, how many wrong answers make a question stubborn, and the final-week plan
列出每门课；点开一门课可以记下考试形式、日期、总分和重点知识点，也能把两门课合并: Lists every course; open one to record the exam format, date, total marks and key topics, or merge two courses
备考补习的个人默认值：是否自动识别资料用途、清单语言，以及是否默认列出其它课程的: Your defaults for Exam prep: whether material roles are recognised automatically, the checklist language and whether materials of other courses are listed by default
填转写用的密钥（Gemini 或国内能直连的硅基流动），也选课堂实录用云端还是本: Enter a transcription API key (Groq, Gemini, or SiliconFlow for mainland China) and choose whether live class uses cloud or offline local transcription
给上百页的大教材用：装好后，整本书出题时只挑出相关页面给 AI 看: For textbooks of hundreds of pages: once installed, making questions from a whole book shows the AI only the relevant pages
载入或移除示例课程、重新看功能导览，也管理陪学的学习画像: Load or remove the sample course, retake the feature tour and manage the study-coach profile
各处提示和引导什么时候出现，以及 AI 带学的默认设置: When each tip and guide appears, and the default settings of AI-guided study
从旧学习库导入、间隔复习（FSRS-6）的参数，以及整个学习库的备份与恢复: Import from an old library, the spaced review (FSRS-6) parameters, and backup and restore of the whole library
报问题时用：复制一段文字，里面只有版本、界面语言、页面、出错类型、程序自带的报错: Use this when you report a problem: it copies a text with only the version, interface language, page, error type, the program's own short error phrase, the names of the functions where it broke, job kinds and statuses, the number of sources, decks and questions, whether experimental features are on, and a few timings from the time StudyHub has been open (how long switching pages took, how many long tasks over 50 ms ran, how large the library data was and how long it took to apply), kept in memory only and gone when you close it. Any other error text is not copied, only its length. You can read the text before copying, and you add the DSH version yourself. When a page fails, the failure notice has the same button.
看当前版本和最新已知版本，检查更新；有新版本时在这里升级: See the current and latest known versions, check for updates and upgrade here when there is a new one
只在这台电脑上记你用了哪些功能、各用了几次；默认关闭，可以随时查看、导出、暂停和: Records on this computer only which features you used and how often; off by default, and it can be viewed, exported, paused and deleted any time

三种现成的出法：快问（最省）、情境题（默认）、逐题精出（最细）。选了资料后，每种: Three ready ways to write a deck: Quick (the cheapest), Scenario (the default) and Step by step (the most careful). Once materials are chosen, each shows its rough cost against “Scenario”; other combinations are under “More options”.
出题时资料要覆盖到什么程度：精简、标准、完整，或「自定义」一个题数；选得越完整，: How completely the materials are covered: Lean, Standard, Full, or a Custom number of questions; the fuller, the more questions and the more it costs. Before the run, the tokens it will probably use are estimated from the real prompts.
题怎么写：快问和情境题一次写完，逐题精出先定考点再分批出题；下面的表列出各组合的: How the questions are written: Quick and Scenario write each part in one call; Step by step plans the targets first and writes in batches. The table under it lists the rough cost of every combination. It only applies to single-choice questions; the default is in “Settings › Advanced generation controls”.
想自己定题数时，在「更多选项」的「覆盖强度」里选「自定义」，填一个数或点常用题数: To choose the number of questions yourself, pick “Custom” in “Coverage strength” under “More options” and type a number or click a common one. More than 30 are split into rounds of at most 30. Pick Lean, Standard or Full again and the number no longer applies.
一轮出不完的计划，开着它会一轮接一轮自动做完；关掉就只出第 1 轮，其余的在草稿: A plan that does not fit in one round goes on round after round by itself while this is on; turn it off and only round 1 is made, and each other round is added on the draft page with “Add questions for the uncovered parts”. Lean does not go on by itself by default; Standard and Full do.

这次出哪几种题：单选测验、多选测验、判断题、闪卡、开放问答、填空卡、动手任务，可: Which kinds of question to make this time: single choice, multiple choice, true/false, flashcards, open response, fill in the blank, hands-on task. You can pick several, and the total is shared between them. The defaults are in “Settings › Question preferences”.
动手任务不在应用内提供编辑器、也不运行测试：你在本地写完代码、SQL、推导或方案: Hands-on tasks have no in-app editor and never run tests: after writing your code, SQL, derivation or design locally, choose “Check in main chat” so the main chat reads only the files you specify, checks each acceptance criterion as satisfied, missing or issue (pointing out at most 3 issues without editing your files) and writes the result back to StudyHub; you can also choose “View reference solution” (recorded as having viewed the solution) or “Done (self-report)” (recorded as self-reported, unverified).
新题组默认放进你勾选的资料所在的课程（资料列表上方的「课程范围」只用来筛选资料）: The new deck goes into the course of the materials you ticked by default (the “Course scope” above the list of materials only filters the materials); click “Change” to pick or create another course, or leave it empty for uncategorised.

For a lecturer who talks fast and hardly pauses, choose “Short”: sentences appear sooner, and polishing and questions can start sooner. It takes effect the next time you start or resume recording.
课堂实录的润色状态与重试: Polish status and retry in live class
逐字稿上方的「上下文润色」一行: The “Context polish” line above the transcript
逐字稿上方的「上下文润色」一行写着已检查、已润色和已跳过几句；有句子太长或超时被: The “Context polish” line above the transcript says how many sentences were checked, polished and skipped. A sentence that was too long or timed out is skipped (its original text is kept), and an error shows on the same line: choose “Retry pending correction” next to it. How many model calls were used is under “Details and usage”.

逐字稿下面的选择栏: The selection bar under the transcript
勾选句子或划选文字，或点「最近一段」选中最近约 1200 个字符，再点「选中内容: Tick sentences or select text, or choose “Latest stretch” to select the latest 1200 characters or so, then choose “Create questions from selection”. 实录结束后保存为资料与课堂笔记: Save a class as a source with class notes
先在「课堂实录」里开始或打开一场实录，这一项才会出现。: Start or open a recording in Live class first; this item appears then.
结束实录后随时可以点「保存为资料」，不会因为润色或译文没做完而点不了：它会先补完: After you end the recording you can save at any time; it is never greyed out because the polish or translations are unfinished. Saving first finishes the polish and the translations, then keeps the transcript and the class notes. If the polish made no notes, they are written from the transcript. Anything that could not be finished is written in Jobs.
觉得这道题不好，点题目下方的「修题」：点一个常见的问题（或者自己写一句），后台助: Think a question is bad? Choose “Improve question” below it: pick a common problem (or write a line of your own) and the background assistant edits the card directly. The inbox tells you when it is done, and you can undo the edit there in one step.
在「修题」框里写好一句话，点「存为我的常用语句」，它就和内置的常见问题排在一起，: Write a line in the “Improve question” box and choose “Save as my phrase”: it sits next to the built-in common problems, and one click fills the box with it next time. The delete button on each one removes it (undo for a few seconds). Up to 12 phrases of 200 characters each, saved in the library settings.
先在「复习全书」里打开一本书。: First open a book in Review book.

While the book has no term cards, answer templates or formulas the item is not there, nor while the course’s custom plan (Customize in depth) leaves out the cheat sheet; a plan without formulas or the index likewise leaves the formula page, the glossary and the term cards by chapter out of the lookup pages. Tick them again in “Your custom plan” on the course settings and they are back. Export… has the same download; the whole book can be saved as such a page too, see “Export the review book”.
「更多 › 导出…」把整本书存成三种：一个 Markdown 文件（给 Pand: “More › Export…” saves the whole book in three ways: one Markdown file (for Pandoc), a zip of files, or “Whole book (.html)”, one page that opens offline and prints cleanly: each chapter starts a new page, sources stand at the end of the chapter, it reads on a phone, and the button says about how many A4 pages it is. When you share it, tick “Leave quotes from the materials out of the book page”: the words quoted from your materials, in the footnotes and in the concepts of the answer key, are left out and only the source (its title) stays; this applies to the book page only. 课程有定制方案、也生成了复习全书之后，「课程设置」的「你的定制」下面列出方案里每: Once a course has a custom plan and a review book, “Your custom plan” in the course settings lists the readiness of each chapter of the plan: a thin bar is the share of solid points, and hovering shows how many points are explained, have questions, were practised and are solid; a chapter the book has not written yet says “Not built”. “Fill gaps” first says what it would do and roughly how many model calls, and only “Start” begins; it starts existing jobs only (explanations, questions, variants), and the progress is in Jobs.

Going to a page from a citation, a practice run or “Show N chapters” switches to its chapter by itself, and “Find in text” also lists the matches in other chapters.
在阅读器工具栏最右边的「更多」里点「翻译…」：把这一页或这一章译成中文或英文，译: In the reader toolbar, open More at the far right and choose “Translate…”: it translates this page or chapter into Chinese or English, with the translation shown beside the paragraphs. 数出这几页关联了多少道题、几道到期，点一下就开始练；这几页还没有题时，同一个面板: Counts how many questions are linked to these pages and how many are due, and starts practising with one click; when these pages have no questions yet, the same panel can make some. Click the small arrow right of “Make questions”, or press P while reading.
有原文件的 PDF 资料，工具栏「更多」左边有「文字 | 原始 PDF」开关（窄: A PDF material with its original file has a “Text | Original PDF” switch left of More in the toolbar (in a narrow window, under “View” in More); switching lands on the page you are reading, and the next time you open it from the Sources page it opens in the original PDF at that page again. For a chapter with many formulas whose converted text is hard to read, the reader suggests once “Show the original PDF” or “Convert again with MinerU”. Ask by page in “More › Study tools”, turn pages with the page buttons, and tap a preset to ask at once. Without the original file, add it first with “Add the original file”.
在阅读里选中一段原文，「学习工具」会自己打开（也可以在工具栏最右边的「更多」里点: Select a passage while reading and “Study tools” opens by itself (you can also open it from More at the far right of the toolbar); you can then ask about that passage, and there are one-tap questions such as “I didn’t get it” and “Give an example”. Answers are kept only while the reader is open; save one as an annotation to keep it.
阅读时工具栏里红色的「AI 出题」按钮：用整份资料出题。: The red “Make questions” button in the toolbar while reading: make questions from the whole material.
列出这份资料里你答错或还没巩固的题（和「错题与待巩固」页是同一批记录），当前章节: Lists the questions of this material you got wrong or have not consolidated yet (the same records as the “Mistakes & weak points” page), the current chapter’s first and the rest after. Each question can be practised (you come back here afterwards) or opened in the text at the passage it asks about. When there are none it says so in one line.
把当前这一章按它的标题画成一棵树（章 › 节 › 小节），不用模型、不花 tok: Draws the current chapter as a tree from its headings (chapter › section › sub-section), with no model and no tokens. Click a node to jump there, and the arrow folds a branch. To make it finer, click “Refine in the main chat” and the main chat completes it from the chapter’s pages.
阅读器的工具栏只留「目录」「AI 出题」「错题」「思维导图」，其余都在最右边的「: The reader’s toolbar keeps only Contents, Make questions, Mistakes and Mind map; everything else is in More at the far right: the view (Read / Text / Original PDF), Find in text (Ctrl/⌘ F), Translate…, Display settings…, Study tools, Mastery and coverage, AI contents…, Rename…, today’s related to-dos, the question sets that use this material, and Download the original file.
在这份资料里找一个词，也会列出其他章节里的结果。按 Ctrl/⌘ F 直接打开，: Finds a word in this material and also lists the results in other chapters. Press Ctrl/⌘ F to open it directly, or choose “Find in text” in More.
字号、版心宽度、字体、背景、下划线，和中英对照译文怎么显示，都在「更多」的「显示: Text size, line width, typeface, background, underline, and how bilingual translations are shown are all in More › “Display settings…”; a change applies to every place you read.
自动解析的标题不满意时，在「更多」里点「AI 整理目录…」：它会打开「目录」，底: When the automatic headings are not good enough, choose “AI contents…” in More: it opens the Contents, and at the bottom you can have the AI tidy the full contents or only find the chapters (cheaper). It estimates the cost first and calls the model once only after you confirm.
把这一阶段的资料交给主会话一步步讲清楚、边讲边问，不懂的地方当场追问。: Hand this stage’s materials to the main chat to explain step by step and check your understanding as you go, with follow-up questions on the spot.
像面试一样一问一答、追问到底，检验这一阶段是不是真能讲出来；交卷后给出逐题点评。: An interview-style oral check with back-and-forth follow-ups to test whether you can explain this stage in your own words, with feedback on every question after you submit.
每门课按哪几个阶段学、过关宽严怎么算，以及当前阶段「也可以」用哪些功能；默认是课: The stages a course is learned by, how strict each stage’s gate is, and which other StudyHub features you can also try in the current stage. It defaults to Course study, works unchanged if left alone, and can be edited right on the card or shaped with the main chat.
只保存了提取出的文字的资料，可以补上原文件：打开工具栏最右边的「更多」，PDF: A material that kept only its extracted text can get its original file back: open More at the far right of the toolbar. For a PDF, the "Original PDF" row says "No original file" and clicking it is how you add it (other formats have "Add the original file…"). Point to where the file is (only the path is remembered, no space used, however big the file) or copy it into the library (up to 40 MB). The saved text, citations and questions do not change. A PDF converted from a path on this computer remembers where its original is; sending a page to the main chat from the reader then includes the file path and page number. If the file goes missing or is changed, the reader shows a notice above the text.
每门课可以有最多 12 条、每条一句话的出题守则：以后给这门课出题，规划、出题和: Each course can keep up to 12 one-sentence generation rules: from then on, planning, writing and review of its questions follow them, and “Preview what this run will ask for” lists them on a row of their own. While practising, type a sentence in the Improve question box or pick tags under “Question needs work”, press “Make it a course rule”, check what will be added and confirm; see, change or delete the rules in the course settings under More settings › Generation rules. After a change, the review of drafts reviewed earlier no longer counts: a reviewed publication reviews them again against the new rules, and Publish and practise marks their questions as not automatically reviewed.
一道题答错累计达到设定次数，或最近几次里答错的占比够高，错题本里这一行就带「顽固: When a question has been failed the set number of times in all, or a high enough share of its latest attempts failed, its row in the wrong book carries a “Stubborn” mark (in both views, To review and Corrected). Open the row for a few ways out: have the background fix it, add a prerequisite card because it is too hard, send it to the main chat, or pause it. A collapsed row gains no button; “Stubborn” above the list shows only those questions; and the result page of a round mentions them in one line. It is told from your answer log only, with no model call.
多少次答错算顽固: How many wrong answers is stubborn
在「设置 › 练习」里改两个数：累计答错几次算顽固题，以及最近几次作答里答错占多: Change two numbers in Settings › Practice: how many wrong answers in all make a question stubborn, and what share of the latest attempts failing does. The default is 4 wrong answers in all, or 3 or more misses in the latest 5 (60%; with fewer than 5 attempts it counts the same way). Changes save at once and only affect the marks you see afterwards.
到考试日会不会掉: Will it slip by the exam day
考试日期还没到时，复习全书「期末一周」和「备考计划」里每个答过题的知识点旁写一个: With an exam date still ahead, every point with answered questions in the review book’s Final week and Study plan carries one word: “Holds on exam day”, “Slips by exam day” or “Already shaky”, projected with no further review and never as a percentage; hover it for what the three mean. When the course has a study plan and a chapter will slip, Today’s focus under Tasks › Today gains one sentence such as “At this pace, by the exam day these chapters will slip: 3, 7”, with a button that makes one round of those chapters’ questions most likely to be forgotten.
本机 MinerU 在「设置 › PDF 转换」的「更多」里点「卸载」，确认后删: To remove MinerU from this computer, choose Uninstall under More in Settings › PDF conversion; once confirmed, the program, Python and the models StudyHub installed are deleted, and materials already converted are not affected. When an install fails or is paused, the “⋯” menu beside the main button also has Uninstall and reinstall: it installs again in the same place and tier, downloading everything again.
在「设置 › PDF 转换」的「更多 › 模型档位」里选 basic 或 sta: Pick basic or standard under More › Model tier in Settings › PDF conversion. Once installed, choose “Switch to the X tier”; while an install is unfinished, picking the other tier turns the main button into “Install the X tier instead”, and finished steps are not done again. After a failure, the “⋯” menu beside the main button also has “Switch to the basic tier”.
让主会话修复本地工具: Let the main chat repair a local tool
本地工具（MinerU、Marker、本地转写、电脑声音组件、检索扩展）安装或启: This only exists on the failed card of a local tool (MinerU, Marker, local transcription, the system-audio component, the search extension) when it fails to install or start; while nothing has failed it is not there.

When a local tool (MinerU, Marker, local transcription, the system-audio component, the search extension) fails to install or start, its failed card gets “Send to the main chat”: the main chat finds the real cause first, then repairs this computer’s environment step by step, and asks you before ending a process, deleting files or changing permissions. A repair that changes files or permissions works outside StudyHub’s folder, so the card then says: before sending, choose the full-access option in the permission menu at the bottom-left of the chat input box, and switch back to your previous option when it is fixed (StudyHub cannot switch it). The main chat does not start or stop the tool’s service or change system settings; when it is fixed it tells you which button to press back on the card, and installing and uninstalling stay your own buttons.
这一点基础不牢时，在题目下方的「更多」里选「出前置题…」，写下知识点：后台助教会: When the basics are shaky, choose “Generate a prerequisite question…” under “More” below the question and write the knowledge point: the background assistant makes an easier question, adds it to the same deck as a prerequisite of this one, and the inbox tells you when it is done. Under a saved Q&A there is also “Turn into a prerequisite question”, which makes the question from that one answer.
一道题暂时不会，不必乱猜：在题目下方的「更多」里选「先跳过」，或按 K 键。它留: Stuck on a question? No need to guess: choose “Skip for now” in “More” below the question, or press K. It stays in the round and comes back after the other questions; skipping records no score, and its time starts again when you come back. On a narrow window, “N to answer” beside the question number jumps to any question.
今天先做到这里：在题目下方的「更多」里选「到此为止…」，确认后进入这一轮的结果页: Done for today: choose “Stop here…” in “More” below the question and confirm, and the round’s result page opens. Answered questions count and are scheduled as usual; unanswered ones record nothing and keep their review schedule. “Questions in this round” on the result page lists every question, and each opens to look back at its answer and explanation.
在「资料」页右上角（窄窗口里在「更多」里）或任意课程「总纲」顶部点「交互伴学」：: Choose “Interactive Companions” at the top right of “Sources” (in a narrow window, under “More”) or at the top of any course’s “Course outline”: generate self-contained step-by-step interactive HTML lessons across Mathematics, Philosophy, Mechanical Engineering, CS and more (with parametric sandboxes, counterexample matrices, stepwise schematics, derivations and zero-token card sync), or mount an existing local companion folder in place (mounting needs no AI model).
想让题目更贴近你的考法时用：给每种题型定几道题，或者写下对推理、错误选项、开放题: Use it to fit the questions to how you are examined: set how many questions each type gets, or write what you want for reasoning, wrong options and how open questions are marked. “Preview what this run will ask for” shows how this run will go without calling the model. You do not need it normally; it is folded under “Advanced” in “More options” and opens by itself once it holds a value.
复习全书薄弱节筛选与合书自测: Review book weak-section filter and inline check
在「设置 › 练习」开启后，复习全书左侧目录可切换到「薄弱节」只看有待巩固或到期: Once enabled in Settings › Practice, the Review book Contents column can filter to “Weak” points that have weak or due questions, and each point offers a “Quick check” button to practise in place while veiling the prose, with no model call.
在「设置 › 练习」开启后，复习全书「更多 › 速查页」的「易混概念」旁会出现「: Once enabled in Settings › Practice, “More › Lookup” shows a “Self-check” toggle beside Confusable concepts to mask header and cell concept names so you can identify them from the clues before revealing, with no model call.
在「设置 › 练习」打开后，「找功能」（Ctrl K 或 /）未输入搜索词时，会: Once turned on in Settings › Practice, opening Find a feature (Ctrl K or /) with no query places four learning situations above the index (starting with new materials, clearing mistakes, asking and testing while reading, and pre-exam timed checks), linking three steps in order and expanding the closest fit to your current materials, questions, and weak points. Press “Take me there” on any step to jump straight there, with no model call.
刚加新资料，先搭起第一轮练习: New materials added: start your first round
先把讲义、课件或课堂笔记放进资料库，长 PDF 也能按章打开。: Add handouts, slides, or lecture notes to Sources first; long PDFs open chapter by chapter.
难啃的章节先做成逐句互动伴学课，边调参数或看反例边读懂。: Turn tough chapters into step-by-step interactive companion lessons with sandboxes and counterexamples.
选好刚读完的资料出题，发布后马上进入第一轮练习。: Pick the materials you just read, generate questions, and publish straight into your first round.
边读讲义边提问，读完几页当场自测: Ask as you read, then test these pages
读到卡壳的段落直接划词追问，把关键解释存成批注留在原处。: Select a confusing passage to ask about it right away and keep helpful answers as annotations.
刚读完这几页就趁热练关联题；还没有题时原处直接补出。: Practise the questions linked to the pages you just read, or add some there when none exist yet.
集中回看这份资料里还没巩固的题，点一下跳回它考的那一段。: See all unsettled mistakes tied to this material and jump straight back to the passage each asks about.
刚刷完题有错漏，集中清掉薄弱点: After practice: clear weak points together
把待巩固的错题连同题库里的同类题排成一轮，趁余温再闯一遍。: Queue your mistakes with similar bank questions into one round while the mistakes are still fresh.
反复答错的题拆开处理：交给后台修题、补一道前置基础题或回看原文。: Tackle repeated misses separately: have the background fix the card, add a prerequisite, or revisit the source.
换个问法再考一次同一个考点，确认是真懂而不是背下了原题。: Test the same point with fresh wording so you verify understanding rather than memorizing one question.
考前突击查漏，限时模考检验底线: Pre-exam sprint: review gaps and take a timed exam
把整门课的考点、问答与易错点串成一本书通读，顺手查漏补缺。: Read the course’s key points, Q&As, and common traps in one structured book to spot missing pieces.
把易混对照、公式与术语卡收成两栏速查页，考前快速过一遍。: Scan confusable pairs, formulas, and term cards on a dense two-column sheet before the exam.
按真实题型与时限做一套笔试、案例卷或口头面试，交卷看逐题解析。: Take a timed written paper, case exam, or oral interview in real exam format and review each item afterwards.
在「设置 › 练习」开启后，模拟考试笔试报告会区分已作答正确率与未作答题，并提供: After turning it on in Settings › Practice, written exam reports distinguish answered accuracy from unanswered items and add “Practise wrong”, “Practise unanswered”, “Open source”, and “Practise this question” shortcuts (zero model tokens).
在「设置 › 练习」开启后，交互伴学抽屉会匹配当前页关联题目并支持不关伴学窗口直: After turning it on in Settings › Practice, the companion drawer matches questions for the active slide so you can take a self-check right inside the drawer without closing the lesson, and the course companion bar shows a direct practice button (zero model tokens).
在「设置 › 练习」开启后，打开资料阅读器且尚未选中原文时，右侧栏会汇总这篇资料: After turning it on in Settings › Practice, opening the reader with no passage selected shows saved notes and session answers for this material, with hidden-answer self-check and one-click flashcard saving (zero model tokens).
在「设置 › 练习」里打开「错题页显示靶向清零处方」后，「错题与待巩固」上方会把: Turn on “Show targeted clear-out plan on Mistakes page” in Settings › Practice to list focused practice rows above your mistakes by shared passage, stubborn questions, and single-slip misses. Uses your answer log and citations only, with no model calls.
结果页错题先遮答案与标错因: Blind recall & mistake reasons on round results
打开后，每轮练习结果页展开一道错题时先遮住答案与解析，想过一遍再点「揭晓答案与解: When turned on, expanding a missed question on the round result page hides the answer and explanation until you press “Reveal answer & explanation”; afterwards you can tag the reason (Confused concept, Missed condition, Derivation stuck, Careless slip), practise one reason at a time, and carry the tag into copied notes. It changes neither scores nor review intervals and uses no model.
从学习笔记整套练关联题: Practise a study note's linked questions
在「设置 › 练习」开启后，「学习笔记」目录会显示「只看含关联题」过滤按钮；打开: Once enabled in Settings > Practice, Study notes gains a “With linked questions” filter, and opening any note or daily recap shows a “Practise these linked questions” bar above the reader that launches a round along the learning path and returns to your note when finished, using no model.
打开后，课程「总纲」筛选栏会列出「薄弱与到期」和「尚无题目」两类缺口，可一键把薄: When turned on, Course outline shows “Weak & due” and “No questions yet” filters, a one-click drill for weak and due sections, and a “Generate questions” link on untested chapters or points. Reads existing mastery and counts only; uses no model.
按类型或内容分类筛选资料: Filter materials by type or category
资料多于 6 份时，列表上方「筛选资料…」旁边有一个筛选按钮：点开后可以按「类型: With more than 6 materials, the list has a filter button beside “Filter materials…”: open it to show only some materials by “Type” and “Category”. “AI classify” is there too (it uses the model). Once it is shut, the filter in use is said on the next line, and “Clear filters” shows everything again. The Sources page has the same type and category filters above its list.
做题或看答案时遇到不认识的词，点题目下方的「标生词」（或按 W），直接在文字上点: When you run into unfamiliar words in a question or answer, choose “Mark words” below it (or press W), click or drag up to 6 words in the text, then choose “Fill in these N words” to ask the assistant to build a concept ladder and check questions.
按课程记住标过的词：以前标过但还没学透的词再遇到时会淡色标出，讲解时也会避开生词: Remembers marked words per course: terms marked earlier that are not yet familiar show a pale highlight when you meet them again, and tutoring avoids jumping ahead with unfamiliar terms; choose “Word list…” under “More” below the question (or “Word list” in the word strip) to inspect Unknown, Studied, and Known terms, remove items, or clear the list.
在同一道题上补词仍引出更底层概念、或第二次点「补齐」时，题目下方会提示先在旁边读: When filling terms on a question still points to deeper prerequisites, or you choose “Fill” a second time on the same question, a quiet note below suggests reading the source alongside or asking the main chat to start from the basics; toggle it in Settings › Guidance.
答错后列出生词: List unfamiliar words after wrong answers
在题目下方的「更多」里打开「答错后列出生词」（默认关）：以后答错并揭晓答案时，会: Turn on “List unfamiliar words after wrong answers” under More below a question (off by default). After a wrong revealed answer, up to 6 likely technical words appear with a dashed style in the word strip and text for one-click marking; each question takes one light model call the first time and reuses the cache afterwards.
先开始一轮非考试练习；当题目关联了资料或章节且总纲可用时，题目页页头就会显示这一: First start a non-exam practice round; when the question links to a material or chapter and the course outline is available, this appears in the question page header.
先开始一轮非考试练习；当复习全书这一节已经写好时，答错反馈下方和每条问答下面才会: First start a non-exam practice round; this appears under wrong-answer feedback and under each Q&A once that section has been written in the review book.
在题目页页头显示「出处 · 资料名 › 章名」（没有章节时只显示资料名），点一下: Shows “Source · material › chapter” (or just the material name when there is no chapter) in the header of the question page; clicking it opens the course’s outline expanded to that chapter, with a button in the header to return to the question. Hidden in mock exams, on the result page, or when the question is not placed in a material; shown as plain text when the outline is unavailable.
只在复习全书里这一节已经写好时才出现，位置在答错后的反馈下面和每条问答下面；点一: Appears only when that section has already been written in the review book, under wrong-answer feedback and under each Q&A entry; clicking it jumps straight to that section in the review book, with a “Back to this question” button in the header to return with your answer and feedback kept. Hidden in mock exams or before that section is written.
